use_cases: Display subscription tiers with animated hover effects for SaaS products
Show pricing options with decorative gradient backgrounds for landing pages
Present business plans with scale animations on hover for conversion optimization services
ai_summary: A premium pricing section component featuring three tiered cards (Individual, Company, Enterprise) with gradient backgrounds in indigo, purple, and pink. Each card includes glassmorphism pill labels, scale-based hover animations powered by Framer Motion, and decorative background components. Designed for SaaS, fintech, and e-commerce platforms requiring elegant pricing displays with dark mode support.
